purpose: PR-00 machine-readable comparison index for the Oct. 22 MPC/odometry handoff. Each entry retains its experiment regime; metrics from different regimes are not pooled.

metric_rules.lap_time: Only completed simulator laps count. A trajectory integral or optimizer estimate is not a lap time.
metric_rules.fixed_input_rollout: Offline replay from a supplied initial state and recorded command sequence; not closed-loop MPC tracking.
metric_rules.saved_state_replay: Offline solver replay reconstructed from bag state. Historical live ADMM memory is unavailable unless explicitly stated.
metric_rules.timing: Reported gate is pre-publish callback-to-publication admission; it is not publish-return or transport latency.

runs.launch_manifest: missing; trajectory and runtime image cannot be inferred from the directory name
runs.interpretation: Development command-profile comparator only; it is not production MPC or a matched fastline test.

runs.controller: Production MPC, IPOPT fastline, sealed pre-fix run
runs.interpretation: Pre-fix failure comparator. Its sealed launch manifest is stronger provenance than the later Oct. 22 bags, but this was not a completed lap.

runs.controller: Production MPC, IPOPT fastline, sealed pre-fix retry
runs.interpretation: Fault-terminated pre-fix comparator; distinct from the collision-terminated first probe.

runs.launch_manifest: missing; report-sidecar provenance is not a pre-launch manifest
runs.interpretation: One five-lap default-line success; not a repeated-session reliability result. Integrated pose drift and fixed-input rollout error are separate metrics.

runs.launch_manifest: missing; report-sidecar provenance is not a pre-launch manifest
runs.interpretation: Failed live attempt. 5.367 s is an optimizer estimate, not an achieved lap. Do not rerun unchanged.

runs.controller: Current production MPC on the IPOPT fastline; no speed cap or parameter overlay

logged_mpc_horizon_750ms.interpretation: Closed-loop logged horizon versus later truth; the controller replans, so this is not fixed-input plant accuracy.

trajectory_feasibility_audit.interpretation: This replay identifies failure of the captured suffixes at their recorded states; it is not a global dynamic-infeasibility proof or a closed-loop policy comparison.

saved_state_solver_probe.interpretation: Extra iterations and heading weight did not improve exact acceptance. The overspeed-weight result adds one accepted snapshot only and is not sufficient to promote a global weight change.

qp_fixture_delta.validation: 28/28 sidecars valid; 28/28 fixture roundtrips byte-identical; 28/28 recorded solver replays exact-parity
qp_fixture_delta.interpretation: New post-fix fastline failure snapshots are preserved as an isolated fixture delta. They do not contain historical live ADMM memory and are not merged into the older corpus.

pr04_cold_reference_seed_probe.comparison: same 28 saved states/queues; per-row solver reset; cold ADMM; 8 Jacobian workers; 100 iterations; identical objective and bounds; ordinary cold nominal versus reference-seed mode
pr04_cold_reference_seed_probe.interpretation: No effect: ordinary cold nominal construction already uses the same reference/speed seed rolled through the source plant. This does not implement PR-04(C)'s distinct feasible-continuation candidate; it prevents treating the existing reference-seed mode as that candidate. Offline timing is not a live deadline result.

runs.interpretation: The live failure is not a measured deadline miss. Tracking begins degrading after the first full-horizon candidate fails at stage 25; short prefixes are then accepted while steering direction and tracking errors deteriorate, ending in a stage-2 rejection. The collision occurred 138 ms after that rejection during termination. No production behavior or raceline was changed.

runs.controller: Current source MPC replayed offline from bag snapshots
runs.interpretation: Saved-state reconstruction only. It does not reproduce the historical live z/y/rho or prove a closed-loop policy improvement.

post_fix_qp_fixture_delta.validation: 55/55 sidecars valid; 55/55 fixture roundtrips byte-identical; 55/55 recorded solver replays exact-parity
post_fix_qp_fixture_delta.interpretation: In these reconstructed local QPs, most earlier fastline rows remain time-limited and are not proven infeasible. The last two rows are LP-confirmed infeasible; restoring feasibility requires widening only the e_y corridor bounds by about 0.263 m and 0.508 m respectively. This diagnoses local QP infeasibility at the already-diverged terminal states, not global path or vehicle infeasibility. No production bounds were changed.
post_fix_qp_fixture_delta.limits: These are saved-state QP reconstructions, not the exact historical live QP/ADMM-memory snapshots. They do not prove that the entire IPOPT trajectory is physically infeasible.

ipopt_terminal_long_budget_refinement.scope: Only the post-odom-fix IPOPT terminal QPs not already classified as infeasible; no MPC or plant code was executed.
ipopt_terminal_long_budget_refinement.interpretation: The longer oracle budget converts two additional terminal QPs from time-limited to solver-returned solutions; seven remain unresolved after 20 seconds each. Together with the two LP-confirmed infeasible terminal QPs, this still does not establish global physical infeasibility or explain the upstream closed-loop divergence. The solved QPs describe isolated frozen linearizations, not replacement live controls.

pr03_dynamic_feasibility_by_progress.method: Aggregate finite candidate/prior blended-control searches at saved MPC states by unwrapped starting progress; count full 30-stage source-valid sequences and strictly positive corridor slack witnesses.
pr03_dynamic_feasibility_by_progress.limitation: A bin without a witness only indicates that the finite tested blend set failed at its sampled states; it does not establish global dynamical infeasibility. Progress is unwrapped across laps and is not a common lap-relative coordinate.

pr04_source_plant_blend_seed_replay.method: Search candidate/prior-control blends at weights 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75; retain only complete 30-step source-plant rollouts with legal commands and strictly positive physical corridor slack; replay selected controls as MPC nominal seeds against ordinary cold solve at identical saved state/queue.

captures.interpretation: Two cold rejects were rescued among five selected terminal-turn states; objective worsened on the jointly accepted rows.
Seven cold rejects were rescued in this selected set; this is a successful-reference capture and not an independent live-policy test.

Net acceptance unchanged, with four baseline failures rescued and four baseline accepts lost; accepted-set median objective worsened and median corridor margin decreased. This is direct evidence against promoting the seed selector as a general policy.

test_results.python_unittest: 20 tests passed: trajectory-feasibility audit and blended-continuation replay suites

pr04_source_plant_blend_seed_replay.decision: Keep this as an offline diagnostic only. It establishes that full-horizon source-plant-feasible sequences can improve solver acceptance on selected states, but held-out fastline transfer has equal net acceptance with material regressions and worse quality metrics. PR-04 recovery-policy exit gate is not met; continue with rescue-versus-regression diagnostics and PR-03 per-progress dynamic feasibility analysis.

pr04_exact_objective_lower_envelope.limitation: Offline lower envelope only: source seeds were preselected for validity, cold and seeded solves were separate counterfactuals, and no candidate-generation runtime or live closed-loop transfer was measured.

pr04_same_cycle_objective_selector.limitation: This is a saved-state replay of selected states with an available exact-valid blend seed. It does not measure seed-generation latency, sequential closed-loop behavior, or Unity live transfer.

limitations: Only states with a tested source-valid candidate/prior blend have a source seed; all other states use the ordinary cold replay.
The seed search and repeated source-plant validation cost is excluded from replay timings.
No historical live ADMM memory is available; this is not a closed-loop or Unity-live policy comparison.
The selector can increase exact acceptance while worsening the production nonlinear objective on some jointly valid states; no promotion is justified.
pr04_current_build_quality_selector.decision: PR-04 quality/no-regression gate remains open; do not launch the faster line or change production behavior.

pr04_current_build_quality_selector_v3.selector_correction: At seeded states, compare all available exact-valid candidates (ordinary cold MPC, source-feasible seed, and source-seeded MPC); the previous v2 selector compared only the seed with its seeded MPC update and could choose a much worse action than an already-computed cold solution.

worst_cost_outlier_diagnosis.interpretation: The cold solve converges cleanly from its nominal while the high-cost source seed drives the seeded solve to its iteration limit and a different, high-cost control plan. This supports seed/solver basin sensitivity at this state; it does not show plant mismatch or prove a live policy benefit.

limitations: Selection is a lower-envelope counterfactual because cold MPC, seeded MPC, and source-plant validation were all computed offline; their combined cost is not a live control-cycle timing result.
Source seed coverage remains sparse, and 38/224 fastline-transfer states have no exact-valid tested candidate.
The fastline minimum selected slack is only 5.1 mm in transfer data; robust quality/margin gate remains open.
These saved-state replays do not establish connected 750 ms continuation or a full-lap feasible speed/control schedule.
pr04_current_build_quality_selector_v3.decision: Corrected selector removes the prior 17.57x selection artifact offline, but PR-03/PR-04 are still open. Do not launch the faster raceline yet.

pr04_current_build_quality_selector_v4.same_cycle_guard_rule: Among an exact-valid source nominal and exact-valid MPC update, select the MPC update only if its exact nonlinear objective is no greater than the source nominal; otherwise retain the source nominal. Cold-MPC result is separately computed for offline comparison, not part of this same-cycle guard.

rounded_log_control_reconstruction.limitation: PLAN_CONTROLS diagnostics print six significant digits; this breakdown replays the rounded sequence. Treat term split as indicative, not exact attribution.

cold_plan_seeded_merit_diagnostic.interpretation: A corridor-valid QP update from a source-feasible seed can sharply worsen the exact nonlinear objective; exact corridor validity alone does not certify objective quality. This is offline evidence for testing a nonlinear merit condition.

pr04_current_build_quality_selector_v4.decision: The fastline remains gated. The offline selector is quality-safe versus the cold candidate only because it explicitly includes cold; the same-cycle seed guard is not equivalent and can be much costlier than cold. No connected full-lap schedule or live recovery policy is established.

pr04_current_build_seed_reproducibility.interpretation: The prior accepted-MPC result is not reproducible with the current replay binary on the identical state and seed. The seed is source-valid; the current MPC update rejects. This is build-specific solver evidence, not Unity-live evidence.

pr03_terminal_throttle_probe.interpretation: A lower-speed exact source-plant continuation exists from this state. Higher throttle with the tested steering is corridor-infeasible. This is a local witness/finite search result, not a global fastest-line proof or Unity-live validation.

pr04_branch_next_epoch_recovery.method: Re-run candidate/prior 75 ms branch endpoints from the sealed run-5 bag, then compare 750 ms cold MPC replay with a source-plant-feasible nominal seed using three line-search backtracks (including alpha=0.125). Source feasibility search uses the production nonlinear objective and exact in-process source plant; finite search is not a global infeasibility proof.

source_continuation_transfer.interpretation: One optimized witness rescues both endpoints of one nearby pair when transferred; this is not broad-state evidence. The source continuation is slow and has large cross-track/heading costs.

full_stage_refinement.interpretation: The exact source objective improved about 3.2%, but the optimizer reported incompatible constraints and the accepted prior-branch MPC rollout retained only 3.9 mm beyond its configured corridor margin. In both endpoint replays the corridor-valid MPC update increased exact nonlinear objective relative to the shifted valid seed; current line-search acceptance does not require cost improvement. Not robust enough to promote.

pr04_branch_next_epoch_recovery.decision: PR-04 exit gate remains open. No production recovery policy or faster trajectory is promoted. A live fastline run is still deferred until recovery quality and default-line no-regression are established.

provenance_limit: The Oct. 22 live-run report sidecars do not replace a sealed pre-launch manifest. The Oct. 21 pre-fix probes and mpc_fastline_5lap_20261022 have sealed pre-launch manifests; other Oct. 22 report-only captures do not. Comparisons across these captures are descriptive, not randomized paired causal estimates.
